The seal is balancing a ball on its nose while sitting on a platform; on a nearby rock, there are two other balls. The number of fish in the zookeeper's bucket is twice the total number of balls in the scene. A family is watching the seal show from bleachers positioned around the pool. The father is taking photos with a camera while pointing at the seal. A child is holding cotton candy while tugging on her mother's sleeve. The mother is carrying a map while looking at her daughter. Near the elephant enclosure, another zookeeper is cleaning the habitat with a hose. The modern seal enclosure looks newer and more well-maintained than the older, concrete elephant enclosure. A peacock is walking freely on the path while visitors watch from behind a rope barrier.
